name: @blind-flange/dsh-client-ui-base
description: Blind Flange base client plugin: the mount seam our panels take their declared slots from

blindFlange.note: The harness version this plugin was written and verified against. A peer dependency was tried first and rejected: the host supplies its client packages at runtime rather than through our node_modules, so the peer is unmet by design and the pin is a record, not a resolvable constraint. docs/profile-install.md is where that record is enforced.
